description:
[read-only] The brand's default writing voice: tone, style and keywords to write copy in. Not a speaking voice (see list_voices). `brandId` from list_brands, or `personal`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brand/voices.)

brandId.description: Brand id (GET /api/v2/brands), or `personal`. Default: a bound key's brand, else your active brand. A bound key may only name its own brand.

name: get_brand_voice
title: Get the brand writing voice
